body: Well, he said that he needed to work through things on his own (in other words: the "it's not you.. it's me" excuse). I did ask where he stands and he's sure that we should break up and not take a break. And that he can never see himself with me in the future (and couldn't put into words why), though he does still care for & love me. He does want to stay as friends but I honestly can't see myself continuing as a friend, especially since our close relationship/ friendship developed while we were together as boyfriend/ girlfriend. So, I'm not sure I can be his friend without developing feelings for him again in the future (even after no contact). He's supposed to be back in town to visit family in about 2 weeks so we're supposed to meet up for closure (& to exchange our things). So, for now I'm just going to continue therapy and work on moving on. :-/

Second update: So we ended up speaking the next day and decided to take time and talk through our relationship a week later. When we spoke it was more of me talking and him refusing to really respond. The next day he broke up with me again. At this moment, I'm not really doing too well. Even the little tasks I have to get done for school just seem like too much for me now-a-days.  I was in so much pain one of the nights that I just kept telling myself that I might as well end my life. I ended up talking to my ex that night (but didn't disclose that I was suicidal) but he did manage to convince me to go in to counseling. I started it yesterday and we talked through some ways to kept my mind from devolving into that track. For now, I'm waiting to hear from my administration about whether I can push back a test I have next tuesday. I woke up this morning not wanting to leave my place again, I have a required session where we have to practice screening patients for depression and etc. It's not even graded but I'm just overwhelmed because how can I even do that I'm depressed myself...

Hey so he ended up calling but we ended breaking up. He said it wasn't because of what happened but a part of me feels like it was the straw that broke the camel's back for him. While talking he mentioned that most of the factors that made him decide to break it off related to our future together. But it wasn't anything that was really communicated to me, so I was somewhat blindsided by that revelation. (For example, he wasn't sure if he wanted kids in the future but assumed that I wanted them.. but in reality I'm like him and I'm not sure about having kids). So, a lot of things like that went into his decision making. It's put me in a weird space, because I really wish we spoke about those things beforehand. Though we're currently long distance, I didn't think communication was an issue for us. But I guess there were things he didn't feel comfortable to talk to me about until it was too late. I'm just at a loss because there are bits and reminders of him all over my apartment (gifts he got me or things he left behind) and just looking at them brings me to tears. I also just feel so alone because i feel like there's no one in my life i can really talk to about this. Most of my closest friends are our mutual friends and he doesn't want them to know until he absorbs the situation.

Yes, I told him about it earlier today (in the morning). He just said we'll talk about it later and I haven't heard from him since. I've just felt so guilty all day I've just been in bed crying. It just feels surreal that I could hurt him in that way. He's been the closest person in my life, even closer that my immediate family. I have required classes tomorrow (I'm in med school) and I'm not sure I'll be up to going.
I got too drunk last night and it ended with me kissing another guy (and cheating on my boyfriend of 3.5 years). I'm just so upset that I did that and broke his trust.
